ui.siteSubtitle: A candid compatibility questionnaire by Tomi Yang 💛
ui.introTitle: Tomi is Single — How Suitable Are You? 💌
ui.introBody: Tomi is an 18-year-old developer studying Information Engineering at the Technical University of Munich (TUM) in Heilbronn, Germany. This interactive journey evaluates genuine day-to-day, lifestyle, and values compatibility. Please answer as truthfully as possible — there are no trick questions, just honest chemistry!
ui.friendNote: Looking only for friendship? 🤝 This quiz is designed for romantic alignment. If you simply want to connect as friends, study partners, or fellow builders, head over to the friends page!
ui.skip: I don't feel comfortable answering this 🤍
ui.sectionGateBody: Based on our core criteria, we might not be the most compatible romantic match at this time. We truly appreciate your time and wish you the best!
ui.resultHighBody: You achieved an exceptionally high compatibility score! If you'd like to get to know Tomi better or become his girlfriend, leave a note below.
ui.resultLowTitle: 🌷 Thank you for completing the journey! 🌷
ui.resultLowBody: Life is full of wonderful surprises. If you still feel a strong spark, feel free to send a note with your result PDF!
ui.gdprNotice: Privacy notice (GDPR): By sending, your answers and attached PDF will be sent directly to TomiWebPro@gmail.com. Your data is never sold or shared.
ui.messagePlaceholder: Introduce yourself! What made you curious, and what are you passionate about? (up to 1000 words) 💭
ui.includeAnswers: Include all my quiz answers with the message (recommended) 📋
